macros.name: intcalcMax
macros.doc: Macro \intcalcMax returns the larger of the two integers.

macros.name: intcalcMin
macros.doc: Macro \intcalcMin returns the smaller of the two integers.

macros.name: intcalcMod
macros.doc: Macro \intcalcMod gets the remainder of the integer division.

macros.name: intcalcNum
macros.doc: Macro \intcalcNum converts its argument to a normalized integer number without unnecessary leading zeros or signs.

macros.name: intcalcShl
macros.doc: Macro \intcalcShl implements shifting to the left that means the number is multiplied by two.

macros.name: intcalcShr
macros.doc: Macro \intcalcShr implements shifting to the right.
